title: Feature Engineering Fundamentals knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Feature Engineering Fundamentals”?
options: The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.
Feature Engineering Fundamentals establishes the purpose, inputs, and intended output of the technique.
The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
questions.answer_key: Feature Engineering Fundamentals establishes the purpose, inputs, and intended output of the technique.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: Feature Engineering Fundamentals establishes the purpose, inputs, and intended output of the technique. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Feature Engineering Fundamentals” to a new task?
options: Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for What makes a useful feature?; then test it on representative data.
Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for What makes a useful feature?; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For What makes a useful feature?, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Feature Engineering Fundamentals”?
options: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
